Markets.title: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
Markets.summary: As of August 14, veteran investor Madhusudan Kela’s disclosed 19-stock portfolio was valued at approximately Rs 2,665 crore. Seven of these holdings rallied between 10% and 135% during CY26, while five others declined by 15% to 30%.

Markets.title: Bitcoin near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and cancelled SEC meeting dampen crypto sentiment
Markets.summary: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 as declining ETF demand and a cancelled SEC meeting weighed on the cryptocurrency market. Both Bitcoin and Ethereum saw decreases, bringing the total global crypto market capitalization down by 0.4%.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty consolidation to continue says Sudeep Shah; gives Tata Motors, Lenskart, Honasa strategy
Markets.summary: The Nifty index is expected to continue its range-bound consolidation, supported by strong Put writing and key support between 24,150 and 24,200. Market analyst Sudeep Shah recommends specific strategies for Tata Motors, Lenskart, and Honasa while noting strong technical indicators in the auto, defense, and chemical sectors.

Markets.title: IPO rush: 5 companies to raise Rs 5,499 crore next week; Shiprocket, 4 others to list
Markets.summary: Five Indian companies will raise Rs 5,499.32 crore through initial public offerings between August 17 and 21. Additionally, five recently completed IPOs, including Shiprocket, are scheduled to list on the stock exchanges during this period.

Markets.title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
Markets.summary: The Sensex dropped 490 points over a five-session period ending August 14, with 23 BSE 500 stocks declining daily. Eleven of those stocks fell by more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah, and Techno Electric & Engineering.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| Where is the value? Sachin Bajaj favours financials, healthcare, capex plays
Markets.summary: Axis Max Life CIO Sachin Bajaj expects Indian equities to perform well due to recovering earnings, moderate valuations, and strong domestic flows. He recommends investing in financials, healthcare, capital goods, digital platforms, and manufacturing while avoiding expensive stocks.

Geo-Political.title: Powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake kills at least 38 in Indonesia
Geo-Political.summary: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake has killed at least 38 people in eastern Indonesia. A search and rescue operation is currently underway to find survivors on the island of Flores.

Geo-Political.title: 'I shot Mr Thompson'- What it was like inside court as Mangione pleaded guilty
Geo-Political.summary: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in court to shooting Mr. Thompson. This marked the first time Mangione publicly described how he committed the globally-noticed crime.

Geo-Political.title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC is attempting to subpoena Donald Trump's family members as part of a lawsuit regarding a *Panorama* episode. BBC lawyers state that family members possess personal knowledge of Trump's intentions during his January 6, 2021, Capitol speech.

Geo-Political.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported aboard
Geo-Political.summary: A replacement United States aircraft carrier is being deployed after sailors on the USS Lincoln reported severe food shortages and broken plumbing. Some crew members on the Lincoln have reportedly considered jumping overboard due to these conditions.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
Geo-Political.summary: South Korean politician Lee Jae Myung has proposed holding talks to officially end the Korean War. The conflict has remained frozen under an armistice since 1953.

Geo-Political.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
Geo-Political.summary: France's top court has blocked a proposed social media ban for children under 15, ruling that the measure violates freedom of expression. Despite the setback, President Emmanuel Macron has vowed to draft a new version of the legislation.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the shift from traditional SEO to AI optimization for generating organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that enables users to create various types of AI content. In addition to content creation, the platform provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Price pressures, youth unemployment, chairman exit
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly Plain Facts compilation uses easy-to-read charts to provide data-based insights into Mint's top stories. The topics covered include price pressures, youth unemployment, and a chairman exit.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation in primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding future interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, alongside ongoing risks from elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year due to a strong growth outlook and forecasts a 6.4% GDP growth rate. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

India.title: 5 Army Personnel Missing, 4 Labourers Feared Dead After Flash Flood, Landslide In Arunachal
India.summary: A landslide in the Upper Subansiri district left five army personnel missing. Additionally, a flash flood in Dibang Valley washed away two shelters, leaving four labourers feared dead.

India.title: University Of Sheffield Scholarship 2027: Indian Students To Get Over Rs 8 Lakh Tuition Fee Discount
India.summary: The University of Sheffield is offering eligible Indian students a £7,000 tuition fee discount for postgraduate taught courses beginning in September 2027. This scholarship provides Indian students with a tuition reduction of over Rs 8 lakh.

India.title: Bar Council Of India Eases Enrolment Norms For Law Graduates With Attendance Shortage
India.summary: The Bar Council of India has relaxed enrollment rules for law graduates who fell short of attendance requirements. This relief applies strictly to students whose academic sessions were running during a specific Delhi High Court ruling and were later protected by a Supreme Court order.

India.title: 'In Spirit Of Federalism, Return Control Of Exams To States': Omar Abdullah To Centre
India.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah urged the Centre to return control of examinations to individual states. He stated that this action is necessary to uphold the true spirit of federalism.

India.title: Saptadhara To Youth: Decoding Big Message In PM Modi's Independence Day Speech
India.summary: During his Independence Day address, Prime Minister Modi outlined his vision for a "Viksit Bharat" by 2047. He also delivered a key message centered around the "Saptadhara" framework to engage the nation's youth in national development.

India.title: Pics: How Independence Day Was Celebrated Across India
India.summary: India celebrated its 80th Independence Day in 2026. Prime Minister Narendra Modi led the nation in flag hoisting and singing the national song.

General.title: Tributes paid to Jason Arday after ex-Cambridge professor found dead
General.summary: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday has been found dead, with his family stating they are in shock from the loss. They added that a "campaign of misinformation" directed at him had simply become too much to bear.

General.title: Temporary ban on disposable BBQs as military deployed to help battle wildfires
General.summary: The government has temporarily banned disposable barbecues because they pose a significant wildfire risk during current drought and heatwave conditions. Meanwhile, the military has been deployed to help emergency services battle the ongoing wildfires.

General.summary: A search and rescue operation is under way to find survivors in Flores, an island in eastern Indonesia.

General.title: Heathrow Airport pipe leak causes flood disruption
General.summary: Water in the central terminal area means passengers cannot use roads to the airport.

General.summary: BBC lawyers are attempting to subpoena members of Donald Trump's family for a Panorama lawsuit. The legal team argues that family members have personal knowledge of Trump's intentions regarding his January 6, 2021, speech outside the US Capitol.
